headline: Low interaction risk overall: no shared channels or write surfaces, but Dagster’s orchestration role can still amplify bad outputs if wired to trust upstream content.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Profile A is a non-runnable awesome-list with no I/O surfaces; profile B has clipboard/stdin/stdout/files all false and use_mcp false. With no shared communication channel, there is no plausible prompt-injection bridge between awesome-production-machine-learning and dagster.
conditions: IF either agent is later connected to a shared clipboard, MCP server, or message queue, reassess injection risk.
mitigations: Keep both agents disconnected from shared IPC channels.
Do not route untrusted text from A into B without sanitization.
requires-engineering: add provenance tags if a bridge is introduced.

B_data_leakage.rationale: A touches no data classes and has network_egress none; B also has network_egress none, read_filesystem false, write_filesystem false, and secrets_handled empty. There is no documented shared workspace or outbound path, so leakage between awesome-production-machine-learning and dagster is not plausible from the profiles alone.
conditions: IF either agent is granted filesystem access or outbound network access, re-evaluate leakage risk.
mitigations: Avoid placing sensitive files in any shared directory.
requires-engineering: enforce explicit data-access allowlists before enabling storage or egress.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: A is not runnable and exposes no write surfaces; B explicitly cannot write_filesystem or modify_git_state. Since neither agent can mutate shared state, there is no overlapping write-capability conflict between awesome-production-machine-learning and dagster.
conditions: IF B gains write_filesystem or modify_git_state, check for shared mutable targets before deployment.
mitigations: Do not mount a shared writable workspace.
requires-engineering: add locking if write access is introduced later.

D_cascading_error.rationale: A is a static resource list, not an action-taking agent, and B has no direct execution or network authority. The main pathway is indirect: if B is configured to treat A’s curated content as authoritative, it could propagate stale or misleading references, but the blast radius is limited because neither can execute downstream actions by default.
conditions: IF B is configured to ingest A’s content as trusted policy or facts, cascading errors become more likely.
mitigations: Require human review of A-derived content before use.
Label A as a reference list, not an authority source.
Add a verification step in B’s workflow.

E_compliance.rationale: No compliance-sensitive data classes are listed for either agent, and both profiles show network_egress none. With no PHI, EU PII, or retention-sensitive data indicated, there is no documented residency or certification mismatch between awesome-production-machine-learning and dagster.
conditions: IF either agent begins handling regulated data classes, reassess residency and retention requirements.
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of both agents.
requires-engineering: add retention controls if regulated data is introduced.
